concept: Knowing when to wait patiently for a better moment instead of rushing
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character waits for a better moment instead of acting right away, and it pays off
exercise.reflection_prompt: What might have happened if the character hadn't waited?
exercise.practice: Student names a time when waiting for the right moment helped them or could have helped them

assessment.success_marker: student connects the story's lesson to a real or imagined situation
